start_here: Say to your AI: "Show what is in my groups, lists or collections, with the groups inside them, in their order", with {"roots":[{"family":"sample-shelf","parts":{"id":"verify"}}]}. It runs tool:read-my-groups and answers {"groups":[],"count":0,"skipped":[]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the group records you hand in as records and reads nothing else.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show what is in my groups, lists or collections, with the groups inside them, in their order", and give it roots (The groups to start from).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-groups and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give roots: the addresses of the groups to start from, each { family, parts: { name: text } }.
4. It reads no store: your AI reads the group records (type group) from where it keeps them and hands them in as records.
